approval_gates: caliper-verify FIT0403, tyre, hub and radial cable bend envelopes; tape data are +/-2..3 mm
choose and detail spherical or locating/floating pivot bearings and validate bolts/trunnions
weigh the selected Ø200 wheel and measure its inertia, pneumatic stiffness and dynamic ball traction
close total-current, braking-energy, encoder and controller gates before purchase
obtain explicit approval before any xacro/Gazebo Phase-2 work

printed_d200.construction: 8-spoke PETG core, replaceable 4 mm radial TPU 95A tread, aluminium clamp hub
printed_d200.limit: not weighed; slicer and assembled measurement required

pneumatic_d200.inertia_basis: 0.5*m*R^2 .. m*R^2; hub inertia additional and small

drive_measurement_basis.cable: radial near encoder end, routed downward; no axial connector envelope

launch_port_contamination.decision: 4.3 mm is unsuitable as an unsealed clay-court opening
launch_port_contamination.unapplied_alternative: raise the launch-side dock or use an elevated internal feed shoe plus replaceable brush/labyrinth flap

side_cheek_variants_for_phase3.tradeoff: narrow limits side strikes near the drive package; wide admits larger lateral error and relies more on counter-rotating-wheel self-centring

geometry.front_entry: side cheeks only; no transverse lip or ramp ahead of first wheel contact
geometry.full_lower_plate_result: REJECTED: no full-length lower plate at W=-43 mm clears both endpoints
geometry.accepted_connection: forward/elevated supports at X=397, |Y|=237; no member passes through a flywheel
geometry.bearing_arrangement_requirement: self-aligning spherical bearings, or one locating and one floating bearing, because lifted-wheel frame twist must not preload both bearings

normal_force_basis.equilibrium: delta_ball + 2*delta_tread = 8 mm; F_ball(delta_ball)=k_tread*delta_tread for each tread
normal_force_basis.warning: TPU E/A contact area and pneumatic stiffness are estimates, not measurements

slip_and_motor_limit.root_cause_observation: 30 m/s circumference produced 8.25 m/s exit at mu=0.9 with traction saturation
slip_and_motor_limit.interpretation: one saturated simulation datum only; 0.275 is explicitly not used as a predictive ratio
slip_and_motor_limit.warning: exit speed requires dynamic traction validation; no zero-slip or empirical-ratio launch prediction is accepted

ground_contact_separate.statement: wheel-ground friction is not reused as ball-tread friction
ground_contact_separate.status: reserved for drive/braking tests after phase-1 approval

direction_control.intake: +Y wheel negative omega, -Y wheel positive omega; ball travels local -U; deep-guide search uses controlled 1.5..1.9 m/s surface speed
direction_control.launch: both wheel signs reverse; ball travels local +U; zero-speed confirmation and closed isolation gate required before reversal

collection_delivery.decision: use an intake-only high contained guide; keep the basket front floor open
collection_delivery.reason: 80 mm free flight varies by about 68 mm vertically across the collection speed band; sqrt(2*g*dh) alone cannot establish capture

high_guide.function: 197 mm deep contained path, gradual rise and final 4 mm descent into the basket

collection_delivery.guide_geometry: short moving twin-rail handoff docks tangentially into a deep fixed roofed guide; tapered/shorter basket upper front creates the required curvature space
collection_delivery.retention: basket has 141 mm wall height above its front floor, but rebound/escape is not validated until Gazebo/physical tests
collection_delivery.single_ball_feed: fixed sloped pocket and reserved rotary singulator feed the low +20 degree port; detailed escapement remains open

assumptions.capacity_basis: 8.15 L gross CAD cavity; 24-28 practical estimate after guide and packing; 28 used for load screen

cg_and_wheel_loads.battery_choice: rear-centred upright placement x=-55 mm keeps y=0 and avoids the strong lateral imbalance of the prior side location
cg_and_wheel_loads.battery_support: two transverse tray rails and side restraints are packaging envelopes only; retention and local strength remain open

pivot_and_support_loads.basis: 2g vertical shared equally by two side bearings
pivot_and_support_loads.note: old 9 N m and 0.413 N m Gamma values are neither capacity nor reused proof

cad_collision_qa.method: Minkowski-expand measured/assumed drive envelopes until first non-empty intersection
cad_collision_qa.measurement_gate: tape measurements carry +/-2..3 mm; verify with calipers and full cable bend radius before release

local_bearing_arm_screen.not_covered: bearing fit, bolt holes, weld/printed interfaces, bearing rating, fatigue and trunnion shoulder

speed.model: rpm=Kv*(V-I*R), Kv=270 rpm/V, R=0.039 ohm; validate hot winding and loaded Kv

spinup_at_30mps_reference.acceptance: reach command in <=12 s with robot stationary; no BMS trip; record current and temperature

droop_recovery.requirement: closed-loop speed telemetry on both independent axes

battery_current.finding: either combination can exceed the BMS before auxiliaries
battery_current.acceptance: measured total peak <=20 A and continuous <=16 A, or upgrade battery/BMS; interlock launch spin-up against traction/stall

low_speed_intake.acceptance: stable encoder-controlled rotation through ball entry at <=10 A/motor (0.31 Nm); no stall or rebound

braking.requirement: controller must safely coast or manage regenerative bus rise with validated dump/brake path; direction reversal only below 50 rpm

encoder_and_controller_requirements: one shaft encoder per D5065, AMT-102 class or equivalent, mechanically compatible second-shaft mounting
resolution adequate at 140..230 rpm intake and ~2865 rpm launch; index and direction validation
independent closed-loop current/speed control for both motors, encoder input and speed/current telemetry
12.8 V operation, safe disable, current limits, bus over-voltage handling and braking/dump support
controller selection deliberately deferred until bench data closes these gates

support_model.vertical: U3 at X=-65 and X=300 drive mounts on both sides; front-right U3 released only for wheel-lift case
support_model.in_plane: rear-left U1/U2 pin plus front-left U2 roller to remove rigid modes
support_model.rotations: all support rotations free; no six-DOF clamp

load_cases.vertical_2g: symmetric 2g module weight at the two trunnions
load_cases.launch_reaction: fore-aft mu=0.9 rigid-tread reaction plus ball-force pitch moment at the trunnions
load_cases.one_wheel_lift: 1g module weight with front-right vertical support released
load_cases.antisymmetric_racking: opposite fore-aft trunnion forces; crossbar assessed by relative bearing-X motion

limitations: ideal bonded beam joints; bearing block, bolts and printed layer interfaces omitted
loads are phase-1 estimates, not measured dynamics
beam peak stress is not a hole/notch allowable or fatigue result
local arm screen is reported separately; bearing fit, bolts, trunnion shoulder and fatigue remain open
